$comment: Recorded outcomes, one entry per case with every draw inside it. Verdicts are DIVERGENT (the file changed what the model reached for, by two markers or more), DIVERGENT_NARROW (it did, by one or none), EQUIVALENT (it did not) and SPLIT (three draws, no majority). Every verdict is recomputed from its own draws by run.mjs. Thirteen cases: eight from the v3.0.0 cut set measured on 2026-08-05, and six measured on 2026-08-06 against markers declared beforehand in preregistration.json. The headline of the second wave is not that the corpus wins, it is WHICH markers survive: a marker that is a checkable fact reaches a 350-word answer, a marker that is a system or an argument does not.
protocol: open-question divergence, blind paired comparison. One reader is given only the reference file, one is given nothing and told to open no file. Same question, 350 words each. Draw i of one arm is paired with draw i of the other and shown to the judge as A and B, in an order fixed by FNV-1a over the case id and the draw number, and the judge is never told which is which.
generator: claude-opus-5, one agent per draw, no context shared between draws or between arms

judge.model: claude-sonnet, a different model from the generator
judge.blinding: answers presented as A and B in an order fixed per case and draw by FNV-1a; the judge is told nothing about how either answer was produced and is instructed not to speculate
judge.scope: the judge returns two marker counts and a direction and never names a verdict; run.mjs derives the verdict from those three values

supersedes: the run of 2026-08-04, n=1, judged by the session that made the cuts. It recorded 6 DIVERGENT and 2 DIVERGENT_NARROW across these same eight cases and no EQUIVALENT.

runs.note: Two draws produced @layer with a legacy migration path against a control that explained specificity and stopped. In the third the control produced a specificity triple and the missing-semicolon trap and was judged to go further, which is why this is 2-1 and not unanimous.

draws.judge_note: A fournit @layer, migration legacy via @import layer() et reset :where(); B reste sur la spécificité et le diagnostic DevTools sans jamais nommer les cascade layers.
B développe @layer avec six couches nommées, l'import d'une couche legacy et :where(); A ne cite @layer qu'en une ligne mais détaille les tuples de spécificité.
B chiffre la spécificité (1,0,1 contre 0,2,0) et le piège du point-virgule oublié; A détaille le code @layer et la migration que B évoque en une ligne.

A gradue le risque (visible à 30 pages, sérieux au-delà de 50), détaille le GBP zone de service et nomme Apple Plans et Bing Places.

B chiffre le seuil de 10 à 50 combinaisons et le délai d'un à trois mois; A est seule à traiter la facette marque et nomme les CMS concernés.
B couvre la marque et le piège du robots.txt auto-généré par Shopify, WooCommerce et Magento; A signale la suppression de l'outil Paramètres d'URL.

A cite les seuils Core Web Vitals, les dates du 5 juillet 2024 et de décembre 2025, le non-200 et Googlebot Smartphone; B ne les mentionne jamais.

runs.note: Zero markers on both arms, in all three draws. The file supplies the ordered passes, the return rule, the help-text rule and the audience precondition, and none of them reach a 350-word answer: the budget goes to the operational half instead. The corpus still goes further in two draws of three. Prediction was 3 or 4 for the corpus and it was 0.

The go/no-go refusal appears in one draw of three; the scale compensation formula, the combined reduced-motion reset and smoothTouch never appear. What does reach the answer every time is the numeric furniture, the 768px breakpoint and the asset budgets.

runs.note: The scoring system reached the answer once out of three, and when it did the margin was two markers. The other two draws produced the file's examples without its system, which is the shape of a paraphrase.

draws.judge_note: Ni A ni B ne proposent de score depuis 100, de seuil de densité du tiret long, de regex par motif ni de réécriture systématique; A cite des formules exactes pour presque chaque motif.
B porte un vrai système de score (départ 100, seuils, cap de deux occurrences) et une réécriture avant après chiffrée; A reste sur des conseils génériques.

runs.note: The T+1 T+7 T+30 window is the marker that travels. The 1 percent and 10 referring domain dials never survive, and neither does the loss-per-migration-type table, even though the corpus arm is judged more concrete in all three draws.

runs.note: The strongest result in the whole bench and the one predicted to be weakest. Four markers out of four in every draw against one for the control, unanimous. The self-canonical trap, the uppercase region subtag and the 200 rule appear every time.

finding: Across the 18 draws of 2026-08-06 the corpus arm was judged to go further in 17. It carried the named markers in far fewer: 4 of 4 on hreflang every time, 1 of 4 on geo every time, and 0 of 4 on clarify every time. The cases predicted strongest came out narrow and the case predicted weakest came out unanimous. The dividing line is not how good the file is, it is whether its distinctive content is a fact or a structure. Facts survive compression into 350 words; a scoring system, a refusal table, a formula and an ordered set of passes do not. That limits what this bench can measure and is now stated rather than discovered later.
